highlights.text: Served as the Sanchalak in the chaotic 'Rang De' captaincy task.
Accused ScoutOP of calling her 'Nachaniya' during a heated altercation during the task.
Featured in a viral video where Qazi Touqeer playfully made her and Uditi Singh his daughters.
Called out Amrapali Dubey's behavior, saying she crossed all limits and gets offended easily.
Declared she will fight back if Amrapali continues to go against her.
Gave brutal tags to housemates, calling Kanika Mann 'pampered bache' and Qazi Touqeer 'easily manipulated'.
Was declared safe after the first week's elimination was cancelled.
Got into a heated argument and confrontation with Kanika Mann during the captaincy task.
Nominated for elimination in the first week.
Involved in a heated argument with Amrapali Dubey.
Got into an ugly spat with Amrapali Dubey and Mahhi Vij, calling housemates 'hypocrites'.
Told Amrapali Dubey that she has a sharper brain than her during a disagreement.
Was nominated for eviction in the first week's nominations.
Complained about kitchen mess, sparking the season's first kitchen kalesh.
Entered the show as a former child actor and social media sensation.
